headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 14, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 26.74% compared to SPY's 14.46%. This translates to an average alpha of 12.29%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top-performing portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 49.39%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still maintains a respectable return of 18.68%. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
